system.description:
Start of your Combat Turn, while in a Brawl: you may make a Luck Check against the CR of the enemy you're Brawling. Success lets you Escape without that enemy getting its free Attack Action.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.58
system.summary: Start of your Combat Turn, while in a Brawl: you may make a Luck Check against the CR of the enemy you're Brawling. Success lets you Escape without that enemy getting its free Attack Action.

automation.label: Start of your Combat Turn in a Brawl; CR = that enemy's CR
automation.onSuccess: You may Escape the Brawl without granting that enemy an Attack Action.

automation.note: On a success you may Escape this turn. If you do, the enemy you were Brawling doesn't get its free Attack Action, even though the Escape card lists it.
